# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$98 list, ~$80-90 at retailers)**
WIRED's top pick. It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The iPhone pad tilts, works in landscape for StandBy, and has a 2-year warranty. The power supply is included. [WIRED review and shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
It delivers Qi2 25W to compatible iPhones and has a heavy base that allows one-handed pickup. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25). [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (~$40 on sale, $80 list)**
It is the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges at 15W and includes the charger and cable. The warranty is only 1 year. [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for sleeping: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130-140)**
Your phone and watch lie flat, so the screens stay out of sight. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best if you travel too**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), ~$80 on sale:** the best travel pick. It folds slim, charges at 15W, and has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99:** it is the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested. It folds for travel and includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost Qi2 25W 3-in-1, ~$100:** a lighter, cheaper 25W foldable with a fan that can be switched off. WIRED notes the plastic build feels less premium. It is listed on [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) with code PARTNER18, which takes it to about $82. That is a commission link, and the code was tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**My pick:** For most people, the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 stand is the best balance of build, price, and reliability. WIRED notes that 25W Qi2 makes little difference if you charge overnight, and only iPhone 16 and 17 models can use it. Choose the Nomad or Nimble only if you have one of those phones and want the speed. If you're on a budget, the ESR at ~$40 is hard to beat.

**Before you buy:** AirPods need a wireless-charging case to use the third spot. The Apple Watch pad needs a Series 7 or newer for fast charging.
